title: A viewing request plus a commission question, answered without inventing terms

turns.user: is hafte site visit ho sakti hai? aur commission buyer deta hai ya seller?

model.text: Site visit is hafte ho sakti hai — din aur area bata dein to main time hold kar leta hoon. Commission sirf seller se hota hai, aur deal se pehle likh kar diya jata hai; buyer se kuch nahi.
